key: D major / B minor / G / A, pentatonic event melody
direction: Every growth/house/window/ring/beam melody onset and MIDI pitch comes from the independently assembled scene events, audited against published events. New backing and material sound design; no piano or strings. The night is sparse drone/waves/crickets; music bus is zero in final quarter-second before ignition. Boat answering bell fills the spatial melody rest.

sections.intent: Lone buoy D5 motif over faceted dawn sea and sparse pad
Island rises: event marimba grows from halves to eighths
Lived-in day groove and boat departure bell
Dusk windows preview their house melody
Missing note: only low drone, waves and crickets
Lighthouse rings climb, glass room then true music-bus breath
Ignition and spatial house melody replay, boat answers in the rest
Home and scale reveal, melody recedes and distant buoy repeats D5
Soft title coda over the miniature light
